title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero degrees and the translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop consisting of the first circle centered at coordinates [0.0469, 0.0469] with a radius of 0.0469 units. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0938 to achieve the desired size. Transform this scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the same Euler angles and translating it with the same vector. Extrude the transformed sketch along its normal direction by 0.75 units to create a solid body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction of the normal. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be 0.09375 units in length, 0.09375 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a sketch with a circle
sketch = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0469, 0.0469)
    .circle(0.0469)
)

# Extrude the sketch to create a cylindrical object
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to the variable 'r'
r = cylinder

    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.009375, 0)
    .lineTo(0.084375, 0)
    .threePointArc((0.09375, 0), (0.09375, 0.009375))
    .lineTo(0.09375, 0.740625)
    .threePointArc((0.09375, 0.75), (0.084375, 0.75))
    .lineTo(0.009375, 0.75)
    .threePointArc((0, 0.75), (0, 0.740625))
    .lineTo(0, 0.009375)
    .threePointArc((0, 0), (0.009375, 0))
    .close()
)

# Revolve the shape
part = part.revolve(360, (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1))
